source_comparison.method: Compare the previous fork source edits against the replay with ordered C++ token anchors, then inspect differences in ownership, equivalent declarations and native fields.

include/pso/boss/derolle/TBoss2Mine.h.comparison: The mine launch declaration and implementation take two const Vec pointers. The upstream parameter spelling start is retained.

include/pso/boss/derolle/TObjBoss2CeilJu.comparison: The BmlResource and GinjaTextureList globals use the declared types under the upstream names boss2_common_resource and boss2_common_texture_list.

include/pso/boss/derolle/TObjBoss2Tunnel.comparison: GameplaySoundPacket.h supplies the shared G_PlaySound_6xB2 declarations. The compatibility header also uses those types.

include/pso/enemy/TObjEnePanBARA.h.comparison: calc_part_position takes Vec * and s32 * in the declaration and body. Both callers supply the actual vector and heading.

include/pso/enemy/canadin/TObjEneMe1Cana.comparison: The remove_member virtual keeps its upstream name and takes the restored TObjEneMe1Canadin pointer. Both declarations and both definitions agree.

include/pso/enemy/recon/TObjEneRecobox.h.comparison: The owner has the child and floor layouts, render fades, typed spawn fields, signed mount_type and the recovered s32 return from is_out_of_range. The live size and key offsets remain asserted.

include/pso/enemy/recon/TObjEneRecon.h.comparison: The landing carries the child, particle, and fade fields. The debris entry point is typed on TObjEneRecobox as spawn_debris_chips.

include/pso/enemy/sinowzoa/TObjEneMe3Sin.comparison: The create factory still has its placement argument and is declared at the class owner.

include/pso/object/base/TObjChara.h.comparison: The signed halfwords, typed stats and target, movement velocity vector, copy and initialization members, and offset checks are present. The native body_center field supplies the former body_center accessor, and attacker_id stays at 0x2D4.
